(Q3 FAR FIELD) the honest split from the shuffled-KO control: the FULL-SET enrichment (4.21x) is barely above the generic full-set floor (3.37x) -- so the broad prediction is mostly the responsiveness prior, as always. BUT the RANKED TOP-10 (13.61x) is clearly specific -- well above the top-10 generic control (3.86x): the magnitude ranking concentrates genuinely specific near-field signal. So this does NOT break the far field -- the broad set stays generic -- but the magnitude law's confident TOP predictions are a real, specific, terminal-TF near-field reached through gated signaling hops, not a compounded far field.
